workPackage: V12 P3 – historische Listingreferenz der US-Common-Stock-Population
priorKnowledgeDisclosure: Vor dieser Registrierung gesehen: Profil der Tiingo-Datei (Zeilen je Börse/assetType, Start-/Endjahr-Verteilung, Suffixe, Anzahl aktiver Listings je Jahr mit vorläufigem Common-Filter: kaum Enden vor 2009) sowie Zählungen distinkter CIKs je Formular und Jahr aus den EDGAR-Vollindizes 1994–2026.
Aus V10 bekannt: Abdeckung gegenüber 10-K-Meldern 14 % (2000) – 69 % (2026), Frame 4.329, 121 beendete Listings.
Keine Abdeckungs- oder Verknüpfungsquote vor der Registrierung berechnet.

tiingoSupportedTickers.use: private only; repo holds counts, hashes and tickers as identifiers

edgarFullIndex.note: form.gz = gzip(form.idx); same rows as company.idx (sorted by form type). V10 cache reused for 2000-2026.

sources.holdings: quant/data/market/discover-series-long (weekly) + security master; research loader {identityEvidence, corporateActionEvidence, listingLifecycleEvidence} and V10 common.buildFrame
sources.publicFloat: dei:EntityPublicFloat (USD, 10-K forms) from the private companyfacts.zip of the V10 factor strand
sources.secSubmissionsPerCik: https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json (+ older pages) for linked delisting issuers: 8-K item codes, SIC, former names; metadata, not documents
sources.originalDocuments: Form 25/25-NSE primary documents and 8-K documents for the verification sample only (budget <= 3000 documents in total)

referenceListing.row: Tiingo row with assetType == 'Stock', priceCurrency == 'USD', exchange in {NYSE, NASDAQ, NYSE MKT, AMEX}. The exchange is Tiingo's last known label for the row; exchange transfers are not visible.

keep: ^[A-Z]{4}[A-Z]$ on NASDAQ unless the fifth letter is in the exclusion set
exclude: -W, -WS*, -U, -R, -RI, -WI, -WD, -CL, -V and every other dash suffix except -A/-B/-C
commonSymbolRule.note: Nasdaq relaxed the fifth-letter convention; 5-letter symbols with a kept fifth letter (e.g. A, B, K, L, Q, E) stay in and are counted separately (FIVE_LETTER_KEPT).

referenceListing.ended: endDate < 2026-09-28 (30 days before the file date 2026-10-28); a row ending later is ACTIVE
referenceListing.delistingYear: calendar year of endDate for ended rows
referenceListing.tickerReuse: same ticker on several rows: rows whose intervals are separated by more than 5 calendar days are distinct listings (REUSE_GAP); a gap of 0-5 days or an overlap is a provider restart (ADJACENT_RESTART). Both are counted; CIK links decide whether the issuer is the same.
referenceListing.leftCensoring: startDate <= 1995-01-03 is treated as provider data start, not listing start (age bucket 'GE10_CENSORED').
referenceListing.spacLikely: a unit or warrant sibling (ROOT-U/ROOT-WS*/ROOT-W or 5-letter ROOT+U/W on NASDAQ) overlapping the row's interval
referenceListing.issuerType: linked CIK filed a 10-K/10-KSB in [Y-1, Y+1] -> DOMESTIC_FILER; only 20-F/40-F -> FOREIGN_PRIVATE_ISSUER; otherwise UNKNOWN

cikLink.HIGH_CURRENT_MAP: row ended == false and it is the latest row of its ticker; ticker (dot/dash normalised) in cik-map (any exchange label; disagreement with the Tiingo label is recorded)
cikLink.HIGH_V10_REGISTER: V10 lifecycle or identity case with a resolved CIK for the series whose master canonical_id equals tiingo:EXCHANGE:TICKER:STARTDATE of the row
cikLink.MEDIUM_EDGAR_END: ended row; candidate CIKs = filers of 25, 25-NSE, 15-12B (and 15-12G before 2007-01-01 for NASDAQ rows) with filing date in [endDate-15, endDate+120]; the index company name at filing time must have strong ticker affinity (A3); exactly one CIK with A3 and no other A3 candidate; date distance reported
cikLink.MEDIUM_EDGAR_START_END: row with startDate > 1995-01-03: an 8-A12B/8-A12G filer within [startDate-30, startDate+10] AND the same CIK as a delisting filer in the END window, affinity >= A2, unique

affinity.A3: ticker == initials of significant name words, or ticker is a prefix (>= 3 letters) of the first significant word, or ticker == first word, or ticker == initials of the first k words followed by a prefix
affinity.A2: first letter of ticker == first letter of first significant word and ticker letters are an ordered subsequence of the name

cikLink.rule: Uncertain links are not made. Unlinked rows stay in the reference and are counted as UNLINKED.

coverage.seriesMapping: holding series maps to a reference row by master canonical_id (exchange:ticker:startDate, exchange alias NYSE MKT/AMEX), else by same ticker with unique interval overlap >= 365 days; otherwise unmapped (counted)
coverage.withSeries: mapped series has >= 1 raw weekly bar in year Y
coverage.frameQualified: mapped series is QUALIFIED and in the V10/V11 frame and its loader points have >= 1 bar in Y
coverage.delistingWithLifecycle: reference row ended in Y and mapped series carries listingLifecycle.status == DELISTED_SOURCE_VERIFIED (SEC-sourced last trading day) in the research loader
segments: exchange (NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX incl. NYSE MKT)
sizeClass by public float (MEGA_LARGE >= 10e9, MID >= 2e9, SMALL >= 3e8, MICRO < 3e8, UNKNOWN; latest 10-K float with end in [Y-2-07-01, Y-06-30]; > 5e12 flagged SCALE_SUSPECT -> UNKNOWN)

referenceCompleteness.edgarDelistingEvent: 25 or 25-NSE (2001+), 15-12B (all years) by a CIK that filed a 10-K/10-KSB/20-F/40-F in [Y-2, Y]; several such forms of one CIK within 180 days are one event
referenceCompleteness.stillListedExclusion: events of CIKs whose current SEC ticker map entry has an exchange NYSE/Nasdaq/NYSE American are excluded (class delistings, transfers)
referenceCompleteness.ratio: share of EDGAR events in year Y that are linked to an ended Tiingo reference row (any link grade); a low share means Tiingo's file itself lacks delisted listings of that year

delistingReason.source: 8-K item codes from SEC submissions metadata within [event-120d, event+30d]; issuer-filed Form 25; merger-process forms in the full index within 365 days before
delistingReason.sample: >= 50 events verified against the original Form 25/25-NSE primary document and/or the 8-K, quote <= 300 characters, SHA-256

p4Readiness.STUDY_READY_TRANSPARENT_GAP: n_ref >= 30, series coverage >= 0.95 and reference completeness >= 0.80 in the year
p4Readiness.INSUFFICIENT: otherwise; also whenever reference completeness < 0.80 (reference itself survivor-biased)

independentCheck: scripts/quant/v12/listref/check_listref.py (stdlib, python3 -I): rebuilds reference, year counts, coverage and completeness from the raw zip, raw index files and holdings with its own code
